summary: Dock GPU selection and adapter labeling disagree with the multi-GPU system.

judgment.rationale: Dock GPU selection and adapter labeling disagree with the multi-GPU system. Hypothesis: the dock retains a single sampled adapter or mismatches selector identity with enumerated GPU data. This is an initial investigation direction, not a runtime-confirmed diagnosis.
evidence: Multiple reporters with Intel/AMD integrated and NVIDIA discrete GPUs confirm missing GPU 1 and temperature on 0.100.0/0.100.2.
Task Manager index ordering is not by itself a stable adapter identity contract; not all devices expose temperature.

plan: Enumerate adapter identities and verify selector traversal uses every supported adapter.
Keep adapter name/identity consistent with the selected samples, without assuming Task Manager numbering.
Display unavailable temperature explicitly instead of fabricating a value.
